text: The Parade in Island Bay is flooded again outside the shops, water over the kerb and into two doorways. Second time this month. Anyone else seeing this?

title: Island Bay surface flooding
text: Reports of surface water flooding along The Parade, Island Bay. High tide plus the southerly swell. Drains not coping near the village shops.

title: Southerly swell brings flooding to Wellington's south coast
text: Coastal flooding is affecting Island Bay and Owhiro Bay this afternoon, with surface water reported on The Parade and waves overtopping the seawall at Owhiro Bay Parade. Residents report water entering properties.
Owhiro Bay Parade is taking a hammering, waves right over the road and rocks everywhere. Would not drive along there right now.
Big slip has come down on Ngauranga Gorge, one southbound lane blocked and traffic backed up past Johnsonville. Debris across the shoulder.

title: Slip closes lane on Ngauranga Gorge
text: A landslide has closed the left southbound lane on Ngauranga Gorge following heavy overnight rain. Contractors are on site clearing debris. Delays are expected through the evening.

title: Power out in Karori
text: No power in Karori since about an hour ago, seems to be most of the western side. Lines down on Karori Road near the tunnel apparently.
Karori power cut here too, whole street is out. Traffic lights at the Karori Road shops are dead, people are being sensible but it is slow.
Large tree down across the footpath in Miramar, blocking the path near the shops on Miramar Avenue. No one hurt as far as I can tell.

title: Burst water main Johnsonville
text: Burst water main on Johnsonville Road, water running down the hill and low pressure across the suburb. Wellington Water crews reportedly on the way.
Surface flooding in Kilbirnie again by the crescent, cars are going through it slowly. Drain looks blocked with leaves.
Road closed in Hataitai, cordon up on part of Waipapa Road, looks like a cracked retaining wall. Council van parked there.

title: Wind damage reports, Brooklyn
text: Several reports of roofing iron lifted and fences down in Brooklyn after last night's gale. One report of debris on Ohiro Road. Nothing that looks like it needs an emergency response but worth a look.

title: Ferry sailings cancelled as Cook Strait swell builds
text: Cook Strait ferry sailings have been cancelled this afternoon with swell of up to five metres forecast. Passengers are being rebooked. Metlink reports some bus delays around Wellington's south coast.
Anyone know what's going on in Newtown? Sirens for the last ten minutes and smoke visible from Riddiford Street.
Lyall Bay is a mess, sand and driftwood right across the road by the surf club after the high tide. Wouldn't try parking along there.
